spans.s:
निगड नि-गड, अस्, अम्, m. n. (probably fr.
rt. गड् = rt. गल्; cf. नि-गल), an iron chain for
the feet, a fetter, especially the chain used to secure
the hind feet of an elephant or a noose for catching
the feet and throwing an animal down, a fetter or
shackle in general, gyves.

नि-गडन, अम्, n. putting in irons or fetters,
binding, fettering.

निगडय, Nom. P. निगडयति, &c., to put in
irons or fetters, to bind, fetter.
निगडयित्वा, ind. having fettered.
नि-गडित, अस्, आ, अम्, chained, bound, tied, &c.

निगण नि-गण, अस्, m. the smoke of a burnt
offering or sacrificial fire; [cf. नि-गरण.]

निगद् नि-गद्, cl. 1. P. -गदति, &c., to
recite, proclaim, declare, communicate, tell, speak,
say, shout out; to speak to, address any one (with
acc.), to tell anything to any one (with two acc.); to
enumerate; to call: Pass. -गद्यते, &c., to be re-
cited, to be named or called: Caus. -गादयति, &c.,
to cause to recite, tell, &c.

नि-गद or नि-गाद, अस्, m. reciting, audible
recitation of prayers or charms; a prayer or sacrificial
formula recited aloud; mention, mentioning; speech,
speaking, discourse; N. of a teacher with the epithet
Pārṇavalki.
नि-गाद, अस्, m. speech, discourse, recitation, &c.

नि-गदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, reciting, addressing,
speaking, saying, speaking to.

नि-गदित, अस्, आ, अम्, recited, told, said, spoken;
(अम्), n. speech.
—निगदित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one
who has spoken, having spoken.
नि-गद्य, ind. having told, having declared.
नि-गादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, reciting, telling, speaking, &c.

निगम् नि-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्,
to settle down upon (Ved.); to enter (acc. or loc.);
inire feminam (Ved.); to go to any place or state,
to undergo, become (e. g. शान्तिं नि-गम्, to be-
come pacified); to be inserted: Caus. -गमयति,
to cause to go in, to insert.

नि-गम, अस्, m. insertion, especially of the name
of a deity into a liturgical formula; the place or
passage in a book where a word occurs, especially
a passage of the Vedas or the actual word quoted
from such a passage; the Veda or the Vedic text;
the root (as the source from which a word comes);
a sacred precept, the words of a god or holy man;
certainty, assurance; a town, a city; a market, a
fair; a road, a market road; trade, traffic; a camp
or caravan of itinerant merchants, a merchant; =
लुण्डी; (अम्), n. a particular number.

नि-गमन, अम्, n. insertion, quotation of words
(from the Veda &c.) or the word &c. quoted; the
conclusion in a syllogism, the deduction; going in
or into.

निगमिन्, ई, इनी, इ, familiar with or versed in the
Vedas or in holy writ.
निगर नि-गर, नि-गरण, &c. See नि-गॄ.
नि-गर, अस्, m. swallowing, devouring.

नि-गार, अस्, m. swallowing, swallowing down,
devouring.

निगर्ह् नि-गर्ह्, cl. 10. P. -गर्हयति, -यि-
तुम्, to disdain, despise.

निगल् नि-गल्, cl. 1. P. -गलति, &c., to
fall down (?).
नि-गल, अस्, अम्, m. n. = नि-गड, q. v.

निगा नि-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, &c., to go
into, enter, attach one's self to; to come or get into
any state &c.; to nestle.

निगु नि-गु, उस्, m. = मनस्, the mind, the
faculty of feeling and reasoning; (according to others)
dirt, excrement [cf. rt. 4. गु]; a root; painting;
(उस्, उस्, उ), pleasing, charming.

निगुत् नि-गुत्, त्, m. (probably fr. rt. 3. गु
with नि), Ved. (according to Sāy.) an enemy; [cf.
नैगुत.]

निगुह् नि-गुह्, cl. 1. P. A. -गूहति, -ते,
गूहितुम्, to cover, conceal, hide: Caus. -गूहयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to cover or hide.

नि-गूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, hidden, concealed; profound,
recondite, mysterious, obscure; (अम्), ind. privately,
secretly.
—निगूढ-कार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, secret in
operation.
—निगूढ-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, well con-
[]
cealed or hidden.
—निगूढ-निश्चय, अस्, आ, अम्,
whose resolve or determination is concealed.
—नि-
गूढ-रोमन्, आ, आ, अ, having concealed hair.
—निगूढार्थ (˚ढ-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having a
hidden sense or purpose, difficult to be understood,
abstruse, occult.

नि-गूढक, अस्, m. a species of wild bean; [cf.
वन-मुद्ग.]
नि-गूहक, अस्, आ, अम्, hiding, concealing.
नि-गूहन, अम्, n. hiding, concealing.

नि-गूहनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be hidden or con-
cealed; to be covered or protected or defended.
निगृहीत नि-गृहीत. See नि-ग्रह् below.

नि-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, seized, arrested; held
back, restrained, confined, subdued, checked; harassed,
assailed, attacked.

निगॄ नि-गॄ, cl. 6. P. -गिरति and -गिलति,
&c., to swallow, swallow up, swallow down, ingur-
gitate, devour: Caus. Pass. -गार्यते and -गाल्यते:
Intens., Ved. -जेगिल्यते, -गल्गलीति, to swallow with
a gurgling sound.
नि-गलन = नि-गरण.
नि-गारक, अस्, इका, अम्, = नि-गालक, swallowing.
नि-गालक, अस्, आ, अम्, swallowing, devouring.

नि-गीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, swallowed; (metaphorically)
left out, omitted, not expressed; (अ-निगीर्ण, ex-
pressed.)

नि-गीर्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being swallowed down;
(with act. sense?), swallowing, devouring.

निगै नि-गै, cl. 1. P. -गायति, -गातुम्, to
accompany with song; to sing, chant; to proclaim,
announce.
नि-गीत, अस्, आ, अम्, sung, chanted; said.

निग्रन्थ् नि-ग्रन्थ्, cl. 9. P. -ग्रथ्नाति, &c.,
to intertwine, interweave.

नि-ग्रन्थन, अम्, n. (probably a corruption of
नि-क्रन्थन; cf. क्रथ्, क्रथन), killing, de-
stroying, slaughter; [cf. निर्-ग्रन्थन.]

निग्रह् नि-ग्रह्, in the older language नि-
ग्रभ्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृभ्णाति, -णीते, -गृह्णाति,
-णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to hold down, keep down, de-
press, keep under, keep in check; to keep back,
hold back, stop, obstruct, restrain, suppress, con-
fine; to seize, catch, apprehend, hold, hold fast; to
oppress, overpower, subdue, conquer; to chastise,
punish, tame; to draw together, contract, close (as the
eyes): Caus. -ग्राहयति, to cause to be apprehended
or seized: Caus. of the Desid. -जिघृक्षयति, to
cause any one to desire to keep under or suppress.
नि-गृहीति, इस्, f. restraint, check; overpowering.
नि-गृहीतृ, wrong form for नि-ग्रहीतृ, q. v.

नि-गृह्णत्, अन्, अती, अत्, seizing, taking; keeping,
suppressing, restraining.

1. नि-गृह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be held back; to
be punished, punishable; deserving chastisement or
reproof.

2. नि-गृह्य, ind. having taken; having arrested
or confined; having restrained or suppressed.

नि-ग्रह, अस्, m. keeping down, holding down,
keeping under, keeping back, keeping in check,
coercion, restraining, binding, restraint, subjugation,
subduing, restraint of the appetite &c., abstinence;
obstruction, suppression, putting down; seizing,
catching, confinement, capture, arrest; the arresting
or suppressing of disease, cure; taking down, hum-
bling, punishing, punishment, chastisement, rebuke,
rebuff, reprimand, blame; aversion, dislike, disgust;
(in the Nyāya phil.) putting down in argument, fault
in a syllogism, flaw in an argument, failure in proof;
[]
any place for catching hold of, a handle; a boundary,
a limit; N. of Śiva and of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa.
—निग्रह-स्थान, अम्, n. the predicament of
rebuke for failure in argument.

नि-ग्राह, अस्, m. punishment, chastisement, (used
in imprecations, e. g. निग्राहस् ते भूयात्, confusion
seize thee, &c.)

नि-ग्रहीतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be chastised or
punished, punishable.

नि-ग्रहीतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who seizes or lays
hold of; one who keeps back or prevents; seizing,
restraining, binding.

नि-ग्राभ, अस्, m., Ved. pressing down; N. of a
verse recited when the Soma plants are pressed.

नि-ग्राभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved., with आपस्, the water
with which the Soma plants are sprinkled before they
are pressed.

नि-ग्राह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be suppressed or
punished, punishable.
नि-गुप्, cl. 1. P. -गोपायति, -गोपितुम्, to conceal.
